mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and restrictive monetary policy, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails when the joint condition (UNRATE rising and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) occurs and SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a supply shock that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust employment and consumer spending, which typically supports corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow at a rate exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand that typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth > 0.5% m/m, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST above 120) combined with weak supply (INDPRO below 100) indicates robust consumer demand amid constrained production, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return prediction fails when the joint condition (HOUST > 120 and INDPRO < 100) occurs and SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the risk of aggressive monetary tightening and reduced real returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% y/y, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.
